name: mcp-facts
description: A factual research question with a stable answer, judged on the citation check (every cited page read, quotes and figures match), the facts a correct answer must contain, and enough independent sources.

input.question: What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP): who introduced it and when, what problem it solves, how it is structured (hosts, clients, servers; the primitives servers expose), and which standard transports the current specification defines? Note anything that changed between specification versions.
input.audience: an engineering manager deciding whether to adopt MCP
